roadmaps.title: References Team Roadmap
roadmaps.notes: Current operating roadmap after closing GATE-SHARED-TASK-INGEST-REPAIR-1 as PASS WITH FLAGS. Shared task context/source-ingestion readiness is accepted for controlled downstream adoption-preparation only. Product-route adoption, target-equivalent reliance, diagnostics, mastery/sequencing, PV, Scale Gate 1, generated lesson output, and product-wide use remain blocked until later rendered-output review and product gates. The next roadmap-controlled step is CHECK-SHORT-EXIT-2 unless the roadmap owner explicitly reorders.

roadmaps.title: Textbook Production Roadmap
roadmaps.notes: Active roadmap for textbook improvement and writing, housed in docs/roadmaps/textbook/. Chapter 2.1 is closed for now after platform PR #48 and lesson PR #13 merged the mixed-opgaven target standard and reviewed-final 2.1.4 target/output. The next planned production direction is B2-2.2-READY-1, a not-yet-started readiness sprint for Chapter 2.2 Elasticiteit before paragraph writing. Companion/product proof, check-surface closure, Scale Gate 1, diagnostics/mastery/PV, and student/product-use work remain separate and blocked until their own gates close.

roadmaps.title: Inspection Standards Compatibility Roadmap
roadmaps.notes: Governance roadmap for Dutch inspection-relevant evidence first. INSPECT-10B merged only a manually invoked internal diagnostic generator and Chapter 1.2 diagnostic report pair from the exact INSPECT-10A source/output allowlists, with carried blockers visible. INSPECT-10C is the active diagnostic generator review/stability-hardening step for Markdown/JSON alignment, source-hash stability, refusal coverage, blocker visibility, and stable post-merge owner action. Evidence-pack generation, teacher/school-facing pack work, public/external generated output or sharing, package-script, CI/dashboard, quality-ref, Scale Gate, generated lesson-output, product-route adoption, diagnostics/mastery/PV, student/product-use work, personal-data processing, and compliance/approval claims remain unauthorised.

roadmaps.title: Golden Workbench Rollout Roadmap
roadmaps.notes: Active subordinate roadmap for the governed Golden Exercise Workbench rollout. It records that the rollout is early governed implementation, not broad adoption, and makes GOLDEN-SURFACE-VISUAL-REVIEW-1 the recommended next sprint before further route migration. It does not supersede the reference-team roadmap or authorize generated lesson output, product-route adoption, target-equivalent completion language, diagnostics, mastery/sequencing, PV, Scale Gate 1, broad product use, or student/product use.
